headline: Callahan's Passage and Palantine Berm Churn as Frontline Clashes Escalate
war_summary: Since the last report, combat operations have intensified along Callahan's Passage, logging eight strategic base transitions over the past two hours as casualty counts accelerate sharply on both sides near Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage. Palantine Berm has abruptly reignited with three fresh base exchanges in the same two-hour span after a period of relative calm. Pressure remains heavy across Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse, where contested works around Briar, Wightwalk, and Crow's Nest continue to trade hands alongside severe casualty rates. Meanwhile, Mooring County maintains a rapid pace of attritional fighting, recording over one thousand combined casualties across the last two hours without immediate base shifts. In contrast, Nevish Line and Stonecradle have settled into comparative lull with no base events logged in the latest two-hour window, though prior structural turnover across both sectors keeps the wider front unsettled.
